study: Franka cable pickup: four learning backends

hardware.seed_cohorts: Seed 0 on A; seed 1 on B. Not replicated seeds across devices.

scope: Two seed cohorts, not confidence intervals. Paired backend comparisons within algorithm/seed only. Different numerical recipes and RNG trajectories; no quality equivalence assumed.

figures.name: learning-transitions
figures.caption: Every line is one observed seed/allocation, not a confidence interval. Each point evaluates the same 128 first episodes under full cable gravity and the final action-rate penalty. Ever-goal means segment 6 came within 5 cm; it does not verify grasp/contact. Occupancy pads early failures with zero remaining goal time; final hold requires all last 15 scored steps. The x-axis counts training transitions; evaluation transitions are separate.

figures.name: learning-wall
figures.caption: Every line is one observed seed/allocation, not a confidence interval. Each point evaluates the same 128 first episodes under full cable gravity and the final action-rate penalty. Ever-goal means segment 6 came within 5 cm; it does not verify grasp/contact. Occupancy pads early failures with zero remaining goal time; final hold requires all last 15 scored steps. The x-axis is the driver's recorded checkpoint write-finished clock. It differs from the parent-observed whole training-process wall in the timing figure; final portable availability precedes the separate full replay export.

figures.name: execution-costs
figures.caption: Points retain both seeds; no confidence interval or timing winner is inferred. Parent process clocks include startup, compilation, collection, learning, logging and checkpoint writes; SAC includes its final 10M-transition replay export. Training loop is nested in training-process wall. Collection includes policy inference, bridges, physics and transition insertion; host phase timings are not pure GPU timings. Evaluation is separate from the training budget. Seed, allocated GPU, execution position and cache history are confounded; full task outcomes must accompany timing.
